parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct trigonometric formula and obtain an equation in $\tan\theta$ [M1]. Obtain a correct horizontal equation in any form [A1]. Reduce to $2\tan^2\theta+3\tan\theta-1=0$ or a 3-term equivalent [A1]. Solve the quadratic and find a value of $\theta$ [M1; working required if the quadratic is incorrect]. Obtain $15.7^\circ$ [A1]. Obtain $119.3^\circ$ and no other answer in range [A1]. Radian answers $0.274,2.082$ are treated as a misread: A0A1. Total 6.
